DIAGNOSIS READY: Drug-induced Parkinsonism (secondary to Risperidone).

The patient is a 23-year-old male with recent schizophrenia diagnosis, started on risperidone 2 months ago, and now presents with a new-onset movement disorder. Given the temporal relationship with the initiation of a high-potency antipsychotic and the lack of prior psychiatric history, the clinical picture strongly suggests drug-induced Parkinsonism. We do not need further questioning or testing to confirm this diagnosis based on the classic presentation of akinesia, rigidity, and tremor following risperidone initiation.
